name: Corpo rifle
description: Corpo rifles were a type of long-range blaster rifle produced by BlasTech Industries but branded for the Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation, who supplied them to their Corporate Tactical Forces as a form of heavier firepower. Tac-Corpos used the weapons during special operations including a mission to the planet Ferrix in 5 BBY. Corpo rifles physically resembled a carbine variant of the SE-14C blaster pistol.
